_meta.note: Conditional (hard-path) VAR forecasts: closed form (Doan-Litterman-Sims / Waggoner-Zha, NumPy transcription of the documented formula, `point`/`cov`/`shocks`/...) and the Banbura-Giannone-Lenza Kalman-conditioning route (statsmodels VARMAX(...NaN future...).smooth(params), `bgl_point`/`bgl_cov`/`bgl_shocks`), asserted equal at 1e-10 at generation. Macro series are transformations of statsmodels' macrodata (100 dlog realgdp, 400 dlog cpi, diff tbilrate).
